purpose: What an official pricing page states and models.dev does not carry. usage_pricing.py applies a rule only to rows priced at the rule's provider endpoint. Every rule names its source, the date it was read and the sentence it rests on; a rule nobody can source is not added. Verified on 2026-10-24 for anthropic, openai, xai, moonshotai, deepseek, google, alibaba, zai, mistral, minimax and xiaomi.

kinds.rate: rate of `bucket` = `usd_per_million`: the official price where models.dev publishes a wrong one, kept until models.dev is corrected; `models` names the models
kinds.bucket_rate: rate of `bucket` = rate of `of` (after the context tier is chosen) times `multiplier`
kinds.multiplier: every rate in `buckets` (default all) times `multiplier`, when every `when` condition holds: a row attribute value, `utc_days` (lowercase day names), `utc_hours` [start, end) in UTC, `since` or `until` (ISO dates, inclusive and exclusive)
kinds.per_request: `usd_per_request` for each counted request of kind `request`

buckets.cache_write_5m: the provider's default cache write: Anthropic 5 minutes, OpenAI 30 minutes, Kimi 5 minutes, Alibaba explicit creation
buckets.cache_write_1h: the provider's long cache write: Anthropic 1 hour, OpenAI 12 hours, Kimi 1 hour. Only Claude Code's log splits writes by TTL today

rules.quote: For Claude 4.6 and later models, specifying US-only inference through the inference_geo parameter incurs a 1.1x multiplier on all token pricing categories, including input tokens, output tokens, cache writes, and cache reads
Claude Opus 5.5 | $8 USD / MTok | $40 USD / MTok; Claude Opus 5 / Claude Opus 4.8 | $10 USD / MTok | $50 USD / MTok. Prompt caching multipliers apply on top of fast mode pricing.
Web search is available on the Claude API for $10 USD per 1,000 searches, plus standard token costs for search-generated content.

For GPT-5.6 and later, cache writes cost 1.25x the standard, uncached input-token rate for the default 30-minute lifetime. In the Responses API, you can choose a 12-hour minimum lifetime at a write rate of 2.5x ordinary input.

Fast mode prices are 2x Standard. Batch and Flex prices are 50% lower than Standard. Ultrafast mode prices are 6x Standard. [...] Cached input discounts still apply to Fast mode requests. [...] When this happens, the response contains service_tier: "default".
Priority processing was renamed Fast mode on July 30, 2026. [...] For GPT-5.6 and earlier models, the response returns priority whether the request specifies priority or fast.

Priority requests are billed at a 2x premium over standard rates. The 2x multiplier applies to all token types: input, output, cached, and reasoning. Prompt caching discounts are applied before the multiplier. You are only billed at the priority rate when the response confirms "service_tier": "priority".

Cache Write (5m) | $3.00 | Charged once when the prefix is first written; valid for 5 minutes. Cache Write (1h) | $6.00. kimi-k3.1-pro and kimi-k3 support Cache Write; kimi-k2.7, kimi-k2.7-highspeed, and kimi-k2.6 do not.

Off-peak rates are half of the peak rates. Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays. All other hours are off-peak, including weekends and Chinese public holidays in full.
rules.note: models.dev carries the off-peak rates. Chinese public holidays are not modelled: a peak-hour row on such a day is overpriced 2x.
